messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "consult healthcare provider if struggling with thoughts of harming yourself or use of any medicine"
set: ["consult healthcare provider if struggling with thoughts of harming yourself or use of any medicine", "call healthcare provider or 911 if noticing suicidal thoughts or dying", "inform healthcare provider if 65 years of age or older", "discuss benefits and risks of treatment with healthcare provider", "consult healthcare provider for right treatment and support", "decide with healthcare provider whether to take medicine or breastfeed", "having thoughts about hurting yourself", "healthcare provider", "tell your healthcare provider about new or worsening depression, mood changes, or thoughts of suicide or self-harm", "consult healthcare provider about best way to feed baby", "healthcare provider may teach you how to properly use the injection by yourself", "call healthcare provider or go to hospital if signs of heart problems", "healthcare provider or adult caregiver", "call your doctor right away if you are thinking about harming or killing yourself", "provide list of all medicines to healthcare provider", "inform healthcare provider if pregnant or planning pregnancy"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
